caveats: Installing from npm needs Paseo 0.9.0 or newer; it is used daily on Paseo 0.11 (Linux server and Windows desktop), and 0.8.x is untested.
On by default, new top-level agents get a card (and a board for a new workspace); turn this off in Kanban settings → Automation.
Boards are local files on the Paseo server, so do not share one data folder between machines or containers.
No drag and drop: move cards with the stage menu or the card detail.
The phone apps are checked less than the web UI; please report layout problems with a screenshot.
The workflow view (beta) reads workspace folders only when the Paseo server runs on Linux.
